description: New Zealand Consumer Price Index (CPI) — Non-standard UN COICOP classification, quarterly. Education sub-index (COICOP division 10) covering early childhood education through tertiary fees and other educational services. Also includes full COICOP table for all 13 divisions. Base: June 2017 quarter (= 1000).
note: Education series begins 2006Q2; prior quarters show ".." (not available) for all COICOP divisions except Food and Fuels. Values from 2006Q2–2017Q2 carry more decimal precision (constructed series); from 2017Q3 onward values are rounded to whole numbers by Stats NZ. Series last updated by Stats NZ: 21 April 2026.

coicopDivisions.04: Housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels
coicopDivisions.05: Furnishings, household equipment and routine household maintenance
coicopDivisions.fuel: Fuels and lubricants for personal transport

education.description: Education COICOP division — covers early childhood education fees, primary, secondary, and tertiary education fees and related costs in New Zealand.

allDivisions.description: Full COICOP table — all 13 divisions, quarterly. Education column (div 10) available from 2006Q2; most other divisions also from 2006Q2. Food (div 01) and Fuels available from 1999Q2.
